theorems.name: Submission.dmcbr_cc_zero_current_finite_sum
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 0), IsIntegerMultiplicity S → IsCompact S.support → ∃ (F : Finset (Euclid P)) (m : Euclid P → ℤ), (↑F : Set (Euclid P)) ⊆ S.support ∧ ∀ g : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 0, S g = ∑ x ∈ F, (m x : ℝ) * (g : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) x (fun i => i.elim0)
